label: Row
description: A horizontal line of columns on the 12-column grid. Rows exist only to split a section into side-by-side columns, for example 8/4 for main content plus a sidebar, or 4/4/4 for three summary cards. On phones the columns stack vertically in source order.
usage: Put the primary content in the left-most, widest column; it stays first when columns stack.
Start a new row instead of squeezing a fourth narrow column into an existing one.
constraints: Parent must be layout.section; children must be layout.column nodes (1–4).
The span values of the child columns must sum to exactly 12.
If any child column sets spanTablet, the tablet spans of all children (spanTablet, or span when unset) must also sum to 12.

gap.description: Space between columns: sm = space.3, md = space.4, lg = space.6.

accessibility.keyboard: Not focusable. Focus moves through the columns in source order.
accessibility.notes: Purely presentational. Reading and focus order always follow source order, never the visual order.

responsive: Desktop (1024px and up): spans as declared. Tablet (720–1023px): spanTablet when set, otherwise span. Below 720px every column is full width and columns stack in source order.
